title: Gen ZX Developers
subtitle: The GenAI Startup Edition, for Generation Z and Generation X, with one objective, a company by the end of the book: proposed on 19 October 2026 and adopted by Dinis as the frame of the second release candidate (decisions 014 and 015). 14 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 19 October 2026, from Dinis's memo proposing Gen ZX
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is from the article 'Gen ZX Developers', word for word; the build checks it. Marta, the BASIC on the board, the path and the serverless graph are the storyboard's illustrations.

scenes.title: Gen ZX Developers
scenes.subtitle: The GenAI Startup Edition: the frame of rc2.
scenes.note: Proposed as the first change set for the board, and adopted by Dinis as the frame of rc2 (decision 015): the founder as the reader, two generations, one objective.

scenes.caption: Who is it for?

cast.says: Is this book just for Gen Z?
Two generations, not one: Generation Z and Generation X.

scenes.note: Priya is 38, a millennial: in the middle. She can read it; it is written first for the two generations either side of her.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, In short; Generation X, too

scenes.caption: The generations, by Pew's dates
scenes.note: Boundaries differ between sources; the book will say which it uses.

scenes.caption: The expert, and her daughter

cast.says: I've been explaining this problem for twenty years. Can I just build it now?
Yes. I'll show you the agent.

scenes.note: Marta (proposed for the cast): Generation X, twenty-five years a pharmacist, Zara's mother. Execution just got cheap; what she knows did not.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, Generation X, too

scenes.caption: The plot twist

cast.says: If we are talking about Generation Z and Generation X, we actually have Generation ZX.

scenes.note: Dinis's origins; and Gen ZX, not Gen XZ (XZ is the library backdoored in 2024).
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, Generation ZX; Precisely

scenes.caption: Explorer coding, not vibe coding

evidence.quote: What people call vibe coding is exploration, and the word should say so.

scenes.note: The chapter that should replace vibe coding, and explain the move.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, Explorer coding, not vibe coding

scenes.caption: From a problem to a company
scenes.note: Ship, give it away, take it away; if they do not miss it, try again. Profitable before raising.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, The objective; The question is whether they miss it (newsroom)

scenes.caption: The objective

cast.says: Our job is to empower the reader to create a startup by the end of the book.

scenes.note: A book with an objective: the one you give somebody who wants to start a GenAI company.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, The objective: start a company

scenes.caption: Ship now

evidence.quote: Not to plan, not to pitch, not to architect. Ship.
evidence.source: The question is whether they miss it (newsroom)

scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, The objective: start a company

scenes.caption: Ship serverless

nodes.label: a model, the user's own key
RiskMandate: a policy beside the agent

scenes.note: No servers of mine with logic in them; nothing to run at three in the morning, nothing to pay for when nobody uses it. SG/Send and sgit for privacy; RiskMandate for control.

scenes.caption: The test

evidence.quote: If it bills you by the hour when nobody is using it, it is not serverless.

scenes.note: A founder's cost of doing nothing should be zero.

scenes.caption: Start the company, for real
scenes.note: The new part, Start the company. The company, the first customers and the community need new articles first; the credits are dated, in the hands-on part.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, What would change; What the newsroom does not have

scenes.caption: The measure

cast.says: we measure the success of this book by how many companies have been created from it

scenes.note: Ask readers to tell us what they are doing, and build a community around it.
scenes.source: Gen ZX Developers, Measured by the companies it creates

scenes.punchline: Gen ZX Developers: start the company.
scenes.note: Proposed here; Dinis decided after the board's hearing: the title is Generation ZX Developers (GenAI Startup Edition), decision 014, and the proposal is the frame of rc2, decision 015.
